scientific_integrity: An analytical stochastic-integral and Poisson-age proof supports the exact weak and covariance limits; finite deterministic program is a diagnostic cross-check only. Distinguish Brownian random diffusivity from deterministic scaled Brownian diffusivity. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson position resets, diffusivity \(D_t=2\Lambda^2B_t^2\) with no environment resetting; fixed positive rate and diffusivity scale, fixed distinct macroscopic observation ratios. Not an equilibrium stationary position law. No independent expert validation, publication priority or novelty certification.
title: Persistent aging correlations under position-only resetting of Brownian diffusivity
